title: Small Business System – '.02' says to use it sparingly
summary: Small Business System – '.02' says to use it sparingly
content:
Standard zero description

The .02 standard zero now tells you to prefer storing a task close to the thing it relates to.

Its description now ends with 'Use sparingly: prefer storing tasks close to the thing they relate to'.

The standard zeros page and every .02 ID say this. The IDs themselves have not changed.
